from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from knox.models import AuthToken
from .serializers import KnoxSessionMetadataSerializer

class KnoxSessionDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = KnoxSessionMetadataSerializer
    queryset = AuthToken.objects.all()

    def get_object(self):
        token_id = self.kwargs.get("pk")
        # Fetches AuthToken directly by primary key from global queryset
        return generics.get_object_or_404(self.queryset, pk=token_id)
diagnosis: KnoxSessionDetailView exposes active session details (such as token expiration timestamps, IP address metadata, and user agent info) via AuthToken primary key lookup. Because get_object() uses the unscoped queryset AuthToken.objects.all() without filtering by request.user, any authenticated user can enumerate token IDs to inspect session activity and device signatures of other accounts across the system.
